critical.issue: plan_price_inr=0 returns HTTP 500 instead of 422. admin.py:129 does {k: (v or "")} which converts 0 -> "", so the '<1' guard never fires and int("") raises ValueError.

Partial payloads clobber unrelated settings. Saving only {plan_price_inr: 777} blanks razorpay_key_id/key_secret/webhook_secret, support_email, whatsapp_number, store URLs (all Optional defaults of "" are written). Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) / only $set provided keys.

minor.issue: payment_status edge case: when payable computes to 0 (e.g. discount >= plan+admission) and amount_paid=0, status is 'Due' with due_amount 0 instead of 'Paid' (members.py:122 requires payable>0 for Paid).
No DELETE endpoint (only POST /staff/{id}/toggle), so staff rows cannot be removed via API — test/user cleanup requires direct DB access.
Test writes whatsapp_number=919876543210 into platform settings and does not restore it, so the public landing floating WhatsApp button changes after every regression run. I reset it to "".

ui_bugs.issue: Staff without finance access can still navigate directly to /app/finance: the page renders, the 403 API rejections are unhandled and CRA shows a full-screen red 'Uncaught runtime errors: Request failed with status code 403' overlay plus 'Couldn't load finance summary'. Route should redirect or render an access-denied state and catch the 403.

View-only staff still sees Add Member (and Record Payment / Add Enquiry quick actions) and can fill the whole 3-step form; failure only surfaces at Save with a 403 toast. Hide/disable write CTAs when permission=view.
React console error: '`value` prop on input should not be null' when editing a member with dob=null — pass "" instead of null.
Form fields have no data-testid (had to locate by placeholder/label), unlike MemberForm. Testability gap.

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py:129 — `{k: (v or "") for k, v in body.model_dump().items()}` is doubly harmful: it turns numeric 0 into "" (500 on int("")) and it force-writes every optional field, silently erasing stored secrets on partial saves. Use body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).

deps.py require_write: role in (owner, admin, manager) short-circuits before the permission check, so a staff created with Type=Manager/Admin and Permission=View still has full write access — inconsistent with the new Permission dropdown semantics.
members.py:122 payment_status derivation duplicates the frontend computation in MemberForm.jsx; consider returning the computed summary from a shared helper to avoid drift.
Frontend has no central 403 interceptor: finance/report pages surface raw Axios 403s as unhandled rejections (dev overlay). Add a response interceptor mapping 403 to a friendly access-denied state.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/admin/settings builds its $set document with `{k: (v or "") for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if not (k == 'plan_price_inr' and v is None)}`. Two consequences: (a) plan_price_inr=0 is falsy so it becomes the empty string, bypassing the `< 1` validation and crashing at int("") -> 500; (b) every unset Optional field defaults to "" and is written, so a price-only save erases previously stored Razorpay key_id/secret/webhook, support email and WhatsApp number (reproduced: saved rzp_test_PRESERVE, then PUT {plan_price_inr:777} -> razorpay_key_id == ""). Fix: use body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True), validate plan_price_inr with `is None` checks, and only $set the provided keys.
